title: Add security regression matrix for remote profile, proxy, and auth
description:
Problem: security behavior relies on combinations of configuration flags and runtime context; current test coverage is strong but not yet organized as a posture matrix.

Desired outcome: deterministic test matrix that validates safe-by-default behavior and approved opt-in overrides.

Scope:
- In scope: matrix tests for remote API, API key, transport settings, proxy trust mode, setup/login protections, and agent write gating invariants.
- Out of scope: external penetration testing.

Acceptance criteria:
- Matrix tests assert secure defaults and explicit opt-in behavior for insecure overrides.
- Test suite is runnable in CI without external dependencies.
- Failures are actionable with clear scenario names.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to close validation gap across findings F-001 through F-004 and enforce confidence gates.
